sloka: सर्वथा तु न गंतव्यम् ईदृशः क्व गमिष्यसि ।देश कालौ प्रतीक्षस्व पक्षौ त्वम् प्रतिपत्स्यसे ॥४-६२-१२॥
transliteration: sarvathā tu na gaṁtavyam īdṛśaḥ kva gamiṣyasi ।deśa kālau pratīkṣasva pakṣau tvam pratipatsyase ॥4-62-12॥

translations.english: 'It is good for you in all respects to remain here. Where can you go (without wings)? Wait for appropriate time and place. You will recover your wings'.
